evidence: Has the P2P label and modifies outbound message validation in src/net.cpp and src/net.h.
rationale: Prevents potential memory corruption and aborts by validating message types and payload size bounds in CConnman::PushMessage(). As noted in the description, 'V1 aborts on a longer type, while V2 can overwrite the first payload byte or write past its encoding buffer', eliminating a dangerous transport-layer hazard.
